annotations.text:
Faq A · axis: grouping.
Why: the breeder's own screenshot of this section is filed as "faq section-too long", and the measurement agrees: the live accordion runs 2009px at 1280 and 2404px at 375 for twenty-one questions with one answer showing. Grouping into three named topics puts the whole set on one screen at 966px, the shortest of the three, and still holds every question in the markup.
Trade-off: a reader who does not recognise a topic label has to guess which tab their question sits behind, and two thirds of the section is hidden on arrival, so the tabs carry counts to say what is inside.

Faq B · axis: grouping.
Why: no tap is needed to read anything, which is the one thing an accordion cannot offer, and it still comes in under the live section at every width (1700 vs 2009 at Desktop, 1990 vs 1997 at Tablet, 1699 vs 2404 at Mobile).
Trade-off: it buys that by dropping card body copy to 12.5px, the smallest on this canvas, and at 768 it clears the live height by only 7px, so any answer the breeder lengthens later pushes it back over.

(Recommended) Faq C · axis: disclosure.
Why: the four questions opened by default are the four the live page already answers first and the four the shipping and pricing sections repeat: documentation, cost, nationwide shipping, DNA sexing. On Mobile, where the complaint is sharpest, that state is 1162px against the live 2404px, less than half, with no topic label to decode and no tab to pick. All twenty-one stay in the markup for a reader and for a crawler.
Trade-off: the seventeen behind the control are one tap further away than in Faq A, and once opened the Desktop state is 1836px, only 173px under the live section.
